passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: Hi {name}, we received a request to reset the password for your account. Use the button below to choose a new one. This link expires in {expiresInMinutes} minutes.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

emailVerification.subject: Verify your email address
emailVerification.heading: Verify your email address
emailVerification.body: Hi {name}, please confirm your email address to activate your account.
emailVerification.ignore: If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.

organizationInvitation.subject: You have been invited to join an organization
organizationInvitation.heading: Join {organizationName}
organizationInvitation.body: {inviterName} has invited you to join {organizationName}. Use the button below to accept. This invitation expires in {expiresInHours} hours.
organizationInvitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.
